text_block_list.text:
On my way to lunch with Gold City, we ran 
into Yukino Bijin in the hallway.
(Grrumble~~~~)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm so hungry...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, didn't you eat lunch?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, well. I went to an all-you-can-eat 
dessert buffet with a friend the other 
day, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My friend said, 'I ate way more than I 
meant to~!' and went on a diet right 
after...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My skirt really was feeling pretty tight, 
so I was thinking I might give it a try 
too... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see. Still, I really wouldn't recommend 
skipping meals.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Good timing. Yukino, come here."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino, is there anything you dislike?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Not really, but... um, City-san? We're in 
the school cafeteria, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We were just about to eat 
lunch too, so let's eat together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B-But still...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine if you choose in a balanced 
way. Veggies packed with dietary fiber, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Soy products are good too. Do you like 
tofu or natto?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! I love it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like grilled fish is on the menu 
today. How about some fish?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I love it so much!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
“Still, um, is it really okay for me to 
eat this?”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, it's fine. Ah, eat the 
veggies first. It slows down digestion and 
absorption.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You know, skipping meals makes your body 
crave energy, which only leads to 
overeating later.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Also, if you're malnourished, it'll take a 
toll on your skin too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yukino has such gorgeous porcelain skin, 
it'd be a total waste to let it get rough. 
Got it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...! Eep! Um! I-I'll do my best-uuu!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All right, time to dig in and eat up~!

I couldn't help but be thoroughly 
impressed by Gold City's sharp eye for all 
things beauty.

"Maybe I can finally solve my recent 
beauty-related worries..."
choice_data_list:
Actually, I'd like to put on more muscle, 
but...
I'd like to know some filling dishes.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what? You care about stuff like that 
too, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
I wonder how I'll turn out in the 
interview photos...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, makes sense, I guess? Now, let's 
see...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, well then, I'll be your trainer today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
All right, 10 more reps! Don't give up, 
keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Working out your lats improves your 
posture, which naturally means looking 
better in photos too――

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, you probably already knew that. You 
are my Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Mm, then I guess I'll just watch.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, I've never heard of such a 
thing. A Trainer being trained by an 
Umamusume.

For months following that day, Gold City 
stuck with me until results finally 
started to show.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I want to know about that too~!
choice_data_list: I've suddenly gotten a bit peckish...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you get a little hungry, I recommend 
snacking on nuts, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, I'll give you two that list 
later. It's the one I got from a senior 
model back when I was just starting out."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawawa~, isn't that classified 
information...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's really nothing special. It only has 
info you could get anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, you don't have it on you right now, 
so... Guess I have no choice, I'll pick 
one out for you.

"Thanks to choosing a filling and lasting 
meal, I was able to breeze smoothly 
through my afternoon work."
